title: RANKX with DENSE counts the distinct values above a value not in the table
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", RANKX ( Player, Player[Score], 60, DESC, DENSE ) )

source.quote: If value is not among all possible values of expression then RANKX temporarily adds value to the values from expression and re-evaluates RANKX to determine the proper rank of value .
source.supports: a value not in the list is ranked as if it were added

source.quote: When DENSE is specified, at the end of step (1) DAX removes duplicates from the lookup table.

derivation: With DENSE the list of scores is 90, 80, 70, 50. Three distinct scores are above 60, so 60 would be fourth: rank 4. With SKIP it would be 6 (five rows above).
